title: Towards Unbiased On-Policy Distillation for Block Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.05373v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) has emerged as an effective post-training paradigm for language models, with recent efforts extending it to block diffusion language models (BDLMs). However, existing studies focus almost exclusively on small block sizes, leaving distillation into student models with larger blocks underexplored. In this work, we investigate this regime and reveal two critical optimization biases that induce severe training instability. First, mismatched block boundaries between teacher and student cause \textbf{\textit{context misalignment}}, providing distorted supervisory signals that misguide student decoding. Second, even under aligned contexts, an \textbf{\textit{intrinsic optimization bias}} in OPD, where the student tends to rapidly absorb high-support signals while lagging on low-support updates, drives a premature confidence surge that traps weaker students in catastrophic overconfidence collapse. translated_title: 迈向块扩散语言模型的无偏在线策略蒸馏
translated_abstract: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）已成为语言模型的一种有效后训练范式，近期的研究工作已将其扩展到块扩散语言模型（BDLMs）。然而，现有研究几乎完全聚焦于较小的块大小，对于将知识蒸馏到具有较大块的学生模型这一情形的探索仍然不足。在这项工作中，我们研究了这一领域，并揭示了导致严重训练不稳定性的两个关键优化偏差。首先，教师与学生之间不匹配的块边界会导致上下文错位，从而提供扭曲的监督信号，误导学生模型的解码过程。其次，即使在上下文对齐的情况下，OPD中也存在一种内在优化偏差——学生模型倾向于快速吸收高支持度的信号，而在低支持度的更新上进展滞后——这会引发过早的置信度激增，使较弱的学生模型陷入灾难性的过度自信崩溃。为解决这些问题……
tldr: 该论文研究了块扩散语言模型在较大块大小下的在线策略蒸馏，揭示了教师与学生块边界不匹配导致的上下文错位以及学生模型吸收信号不均衡引发的内在优化偏差这两个导致训练不稳定的关键问题。
en_tdlr: This paper investigates on-policy distillation of block diffusion language models with larger block sizes, revealing two critical optimization biases—context misalignment from mismatched block boundaries and an intrinsic optimization bias from unbalanced signal absorption—that cause severe training instability.
